item.title: Box Hill Weather: What It Actually Feels Like Year Round
item.description:
Weather in Box Hill: The Year-Round Reality

Melbourne’s weather reputation precedes it: four seasons in one day, hail in summer, sunshine in winter. All of this is true. But the experience varies across suburbs more than most people expect, and Box Hill has its own version.

Box Hill sits in Melbourne’s greater Melbourne, and that position shapes everything — from February heat to July wind. Here is what each season genuinely feels like.

The Microclimate

Melbourne is not one weather zone. It is many. Brighton regulated by the bay. Summers cooler, winters milder. Sea fog in mornings. Wind off the water is constant.
